# Cell editing on nested record fields and in a tree column has no witness

## Context

Leaf of #18762 (its public-proof responsibility). Both surfaces were measured healthy on 2026-09-19, real Chromium (Playwright e2e rig), dev@bd2a404560, on a throwaway fixture: nothing is broken. What is missing is the witness: every tracked cell-editing arm drives a flat `String` model in a plain column, so these two code paths can regress unseen.

## The Problem

| Path | Why it is its own code path | Tracked arms today |
|---|---|---|
| A dotted `dataField` (`user.firstname`) | the commit is `record.set({[dataField]: …})`, which `data.RecordFactory#setRecordFields` resolves through `fieldsMap` and `Neo.ns`; the cell lookup, `data-field` and `isModifiedField` all take the dotted name | 0 |
| A `tree` column (`grid.column.Tree` → `grid.column.Component`) | the cell's content is a component reference; `grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` swaps it for the editor's reference and has to give the component back, showing the new value through `applyRecordConfigs` | 0 |

Measured today (all green, no page error):

- Nested: double-click, Enter commit, Tab and Shift+Tab across nested and flat columns, Escape, F2, an emptied `required` draft stays open, `neo-is-modified` appears on the edited nested cell and disappears when the original value returns (`body.highlightModifiedCells` + `trackModifiedFields`).
- Tree: renaming a leaf and a folder in the tree column (the double-click on a folder's label starts the edit and does not toggle the node; after the commit the tree component is back with the new name, indent and toggle intact); a plain column next to it; collapsing the parent by its toggle while a child's edit is open commits the draft, as any click-away does, and expanding shows the committed value.

## The Fix

Test-only.

- New fixture `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing-record-shapes`: one grid over a model with a nested `user` object, one grid over a `TreeStore` with an editable `tree` column. A fixture of its own, because a third grid in `grid-cell-editing` would shrink the row windows its pooling arms depend on.
- New `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingRecordShapes.spec.mjs`, on the shared `e2e/utils/gridCellEditing.mjs` reads, record ids resolved from cell text (the grid renders internal ids).
- Each arm gets a mutant that reddens it, stated in the PR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A nested field commits through Enter and through Tab, keeps its value on Escape, and carries `neo-is-modified` exactly while it differs from its original value.
- [ ] Renaming a node in the tree column shows the new name inside the returned tree component, and the double-click does not toggle a folder.
- [ ] Collapsing the parent of an edited child by its toggle commits the draft; after expanding, the child shows it.
- [ ] Every arm is reddened by a named mutant; grid e2e stays green; the spec is inside the CI selection.

## Out of Scope

- A programmatic collapse or a store-side removal of the edited tree record with no focus change (no user gesture reaches it: the keys belong to the editor).
- Non-text editors on these shapes.
